content: Ampù para te Kebuyù te Tavang te Megbevayà

content.text: He Megbevayà, utew zekelà is kedsarig ku kenikew.
Egkentahan ku sikew te menge kedalig kayi te tivuuk he ǥehinawa ku.
Egkeriwaswas pa ne egimerat e en,
su wey ku maandam en is menge instrumintu ku he zuen dan menge kuwirdas para meǥamit ku te kedalig kenikew.
Nengazen, edeliǥen ku sikew ziyà te teliwazà te menge etew.
Egkentahan ku sikew ziyà te teliwazà te menge etew he meǥinged diyà te senge nenasyun.
Su kenà egkesukud is gaǥew nu wey kebmetinumanen nu.
He Megbevayà, ipeehè nu is kegkemekeǥeǥehem nu ziyà te langit wey kayi te tivuuk he kelibutan.
Libriya key pinaaǥi te ǥehem nu.
Tevaka nu is ked-ampù ku su para melibri key is menge minahal nu.
He Megbevayà, migkaǥi ka ziyà te valey nu te,
“Ebpekezaag a; ebehinen ku is Shekem wey is Suǥud he Sucot, ne ibpemeǥey ku heini te menge etew ku.
Kediey is Gilead wey is Manase.
Is Efraim iyan pengalang ku te menge etew ku
ne is Juda iyan ibpezumala ku kandan.
Is Moab suluǥuen ku, ne ǥaked ku is Edom.
Igkulahì ku is kegkezeeǥa ku te Filistia.”
He Megbevayà, hentei is ed-uwit kedì diyà te Edom wey ziyà te inged kayi he neliǥuy te verengbeng?
Kenè be iyan ka, is Megbevayà he mid-iniyug kenami ne wazè en meduma te menge sundaru zey?
Tevangi key te ked-asdang te menge kuntada zey,
su kenà ebpulus is tavang te etew.
Ebpekezaag key pinaaǥi te tavang nu, He Megbevayà,
su edaaǥen nu is menge kuntada zey.
